findings.message: 5 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Open now · last orders 2:40 AM" above "THE GRILL STAYS LIT until 3 am."; "01 / 03" above "LAMB & CHICKEN MIX"; "02 / 03" above "CHICKEN"; "03 / 03" above "PHILLY CHEESE STEAK"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 6 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Open now · last orders 2:40 AM", "01 / 03", "02 / 03", "03 / 03").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.border-b.border-line 1440px | section#catalogue.border-t.border-line 1440px | section.border-t.border-line 1440px | section.border-t.border-line 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (DM Sans, Big Shoulders Display, Fraunces).

findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: Only 4 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 596px at 1416px; 612px at 2212px (the screen is 1024px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.
